cases.name: live
cases.fairness: Temporal liveness obligations explicitly imply the original per-action Fairness predicate. Step includes stuttering; nextStep preserves the original enabled relation.

assumptions: Checked formula in TaskScheduler_live: DirtyServed = Fairness implies Services.forall(svc => (s.dirty and s.timer and s.adapter != None and s.registry != NoEntry and s.registry.svc == svc and not(s.stopped.get(svc))) leadsTo (s.taken == svc or s.registry == NoEntry or s.registry.svc != svc or s.adapter == None or s.stopped.get(svc)))
Model fairness predicate Fairness = AnyFire.weakFair(s) and Ticks.forall(k => Query(k).weakFair(s) and RunDone(k).weakFair(s))
The stated fairness is an assumption about enabled model actions; runtime scheduling and provider completion are not proved.
